entities.summary: Richard Clune, also known as 'Rich' or 'Dicky', is a Canadian former professional ice hockey left winger and is an assistant coach of the Pittsburgh Penguins. Clune played in 423 AHL games and 139 National Hockey League (NHL) games during his career.
